title: HLC skew check uses subtraction to avoid overflow on near-u64::MAX timestamps
description: hlc.rs clock_skew check uses subtraction (remote_ms - wall_ms > max_skew) rather than addition (remote_ms > wall_ms + max_skew) to avoid integer overflow when wall_ms is near u64::MAX. The regression test with u64::MAX - 1 confirms this. Most codebases get this wrong by using the overflow-prone form.
